source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model against the ladder gate (coverage and new words measured by npm run ladder:check) and the word-form checks of npm run sq:check-texts. Not reviewed by a native speaker: it may contain unnatural or incorrect Albanian. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit; awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Albanian usage points in every unit: standard (Tosk) forms were chosen to be readable by the adapter; the optative ("Zoti ju bekoftë", "Zoti e ruajtë", "Qofsh i bekuar") is formulaic and is not read by the adapter. Conversation story with the pluperfect throughout. To check: "kisha harruar", "kishte ardhur" etc.; the closing paragraph is a short family reading and prayer in the course's own words (chapter, psalm, verse, salvation, cross, grace; no quotation). Needs theological review.

sentences.text: Në orën tre gjyshja Drita po kthehej nga tregu me dy çanta të rënda.
sentences.english: At three o'clock grandmother Drita was coming back from the market with two heavy bags.

sentences.text: Para derës së ndërtesës ajo pa Ardin.
sentences.english: In front of the door of the building she saw Ardi.

sentences.text: Djali ishte ulur në shkallë me çantën e shkollës pranë tij dhe nuk buzëqeshte.
sentences.english: The boy was sitting on the stairs with his school bag beside him, and he was not smiling.

sentences.text: Ai ishte shumë i mërzitur.
sentences.english: He was very upset.

sentences.text: — Çfarë ke, Ardi? Pse nuk je brenda? — e pyeti gjyshja.
sentences.english: "What is wrong, Ardi? Why are you not inside?" his grandmother asked him.

sentences.text: — Kisha harruar çelësin brenda, gjyshe, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "I had forgotten the key inside, grandmother," he said.

sentences.text: — Kam pritur dy orë.
sentences.english: "I have been waiting for two hours."

sentences.text: — Biri im i dashur! Eja, hyjmë dhe pimë një çaj.
sentences.english: "My dear boy! Come, let us go in and have a tea."

sentences.text: Gjyshja e hapi derën dhe i vendosi çantat në kuzhinë.
sentences.english: The grandmother opened the door and put the bags down in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Ardi u ul në tavolinë dhe ajo i dha bukë me djathë.
sentences.english: Ardi sat down at the table and she gave him bread with cheese.

sentences.text: — Tani më trego çdo gjë nga fillimi, — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "Now tell me everything from the beginning," she said.

sentences.text: — Sot kisha një ditë shumë të keqe, — filloi Ardi.
sentences.english: "Today I had a very bad day," Ardi began.

sentences.text: — Në mëngjes u zgjova vonë, sepse nuk kisha dëgjuar orën.
sentences.english: "In the morning I woke up late, because I had not heard the clock."

sentences.text: — Kur arrita në stacion, autobusi kishte shkuar. Prita njëzet minuta.
sentences.english: "When I got to the stop, the bus had gone. I waited twenty minutes."

sentences.text: — Kur hyra në klasë, mësimi kishte filluar para një ore.
sentences.english: "When I came into the class, the lesson had started an hour before."

sentences.text: — Mësuesi i gjeografisë ishte shumë i zemëruar.
sentences.english: "The geography teacher was very angry."

sentences.text: — Ai tha: « Ardi, kjo është hera e tretë këtë javë! »
sentences.english: "He said: 'Ardi, this is the third time this week!'"

sentences.text: — Në atë moment klasa fliste për kufijtë e Shqipërisë, për fushat, për zonat malore dhe për bimët.
sentences.english: "At that moment the class was talking about the borders of Albania, about the plains, about the mountain areas and about the plants."

sentences.text: — Unë kisha harruar fletoren me detyrën në shtëpi, sidomos detyrën për bimët, që kisha bërë me shumë punë.
sentences.english: "I had forgotten the notebook with the homework at home, especially the homework about plants, which I had done with a lot of work."

sentences.text: — Mësuesi ishte i zemëruar edhe sepse unë kisha harruar të them mirëmëngjes.
sentences.english: "The teacher was angry also because I had forgotten to say good morning."

sentences.text: — Dhe kur u ktheva këtu, dera u mbyll para meje, sepse çelësi ishte brenda.
sentences.english: "And when I came back here, the door closed in front of me, because the key was inside."

sentences.text: — Vërtet një ditë e vështirë, — tha gjyshja.
sentences.english: "Truly a difficult day," said grandmother.

sentences.text: — Por sigurisht nuk është fundi i botës.
sentences.english: "But of course it is not the end of the world."

sentences.text: — Edhe unë kam pasur ditë si kjo. Në mars kisha harruar çantën në autobus.
sentences.english: "I have had days like this too. In March I had left my bag on the bus."

sentences.text: — Në qershor kisha harruar paratë në treg dhe në shtator kisha lënë çelësin në derë, si ti.
sentences.english: "In June I had left the money at the market, and in September I had left the key in the door, like you."

sentences.text: — Dhe në dhjetor kishte rënë shumë borë, kisha blerë shumë gjëra dhe nuk kisha asnjë dorë të lirë për çelësin.
sentences.english: "And in December a lot of snow had fallen, I had bought many things and I had no free hand for the key."

sentences.text: Ardi buzëqeshi pak.
sentences.english: Ardi smiled a little.

sentences.text: — Atëherë nuk jam i vetëm, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Then I am not alone," he said.

sentences.text: — Nuk je i vetëm. Ndoshta kjo ditë ka një mësim për ne: është mirë të kemi dy çelësa.
sentences.english: "You are not alone. Perhaps this day has a lesson for us: it is good to have two keys."

sentences.text: — Ky është vendimi im, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "This is my decision," said Ardi.

sentences.text: — Çdo mbrëmje do ta përgatis çantën dhe do të kontrolloj çelësin.
sentences.english: "Every evening I will prepare my bag and check the key."

sentences.text: — Dhe nesër do t'i them mësuesit që më vjen keq.
sentences.english: "And tomorrow I will tell the teacher that I am sorry."

sentences.text: — Kjo është shumë mirë. Mësuesit e dinë që fëmijët harrojnë.
sentences.english: "That is very good. Teachers know that children forget."

sentences.text: — Po, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "Yes," said Ardi.

sentences.text: — A është vërtet kështu?
sentences.english: "Is that really so?"

sentences.text: — Sigurisht, — tha gjyshja.
sentences.english: "Of course," said grandmother.

sentences.text: Ardi u bë pak më i lumtur. Ai nuk ishte më i mërzitur.
sentences.english: Ardi became a little happier. He was no longer upset.

sentences.text: Në orën gjashtë erdhi Ana nga klinika.
sentences.english: At six o'clock Ana came from the clinic.

sentences.text: Ajo ishte e lodhur dhe e shqetësuar, dhe e la çantën në karrige pa folur.
sentences.english: She was tired and worried, and she left her bag on the chair without speaking.

sentences.text: — Çfarë ka, Ana? — e pyeti Drita.
sentences.english: "What is it, Ana?" Drita asked her.

sentences.text: — Sot kisha shumë pacientë, — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "Today I had many patients," said Ana.

sentences.text: — Një fëmijë i vogël kishte pasur dhimbje të mëdha gjithë natën.
sentences.english: "A little child had had great pain all night."

sentences.text: — Nëna e tij kishte pritur gjithë ditën në shtëpi. Kur e pashë, ajo ishte shumë e trishtuar.
sentences.english: "His mother had waited all day at home. When I saw her, she was very sad."

sentences.text: — Jam veçanërisht e shqetësuar për këtë fëmijë.
sentences.english: "I am especially worried about this child."

sentences.text: — Çfarë kishit bërë për të? — pyeti Ardi.
sentences.english: "What had you done for him?" asked Ardi.

sentences.text: — Kisha dhënë një ilaç dhe e kisha dërguar në spital. Mjeku kishte thënë se do të jetë mirë.
sentences.english: "I had given a medicine and had sent him to the hospital. The doctor had said that he would be fine."

sentences.text: — Kam një ndjenjë të keqe, por ndoshta nesër ai do të jetë më mirë.
sentences.english: "I have a bad feeling, but perhaps tomorrow he will be better."

sentences.text: — Ti sidomos duhet të pushosh, Ana, sidomos pas një dite si kjo, — tha Drita.
sentences.english: "You especially must rest, Ana, especially after a day like this," said Drita.

sentences.text: — Ulu këtu dhe pi çajin.
sentences.english: "Sit down here and drink your tea."

sentences.text: Ana heshti. Ajo ishte e trishtuar, por gjyshja e dëgjoi me dashuri.
sentences.english: Ana fell silent. She was sad, but grandmother listened to her with love.

sentences.text: Drita ishte e qetë gjatë gjithë kohës. Pastaj Ana buzëqeshi, sepse Ardi i solli pak bukë.
sentences.english: Drita was calm the whole time. Then Ana smiled, because Ardi brought her some bread.

sentences.text: Në orën shtatë erdhi Sami.
sentences.english: At seven o'clock Sam came.

sentences.text: Ai ishte i gëzuar dhe nuk ishte i lodhur.
sentences.english: He was cheerful and was not tired.

sentences.text: — Përshëndetje! — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Hello!" he said.

sentences.text: — Kam një histori për ju.
sentences.english: "I have a story for you."

sentences.text: — Sot në mëngjes kisha harruar çelësat. Dera e apartamentit u mbyll dhe unë mbeta jashtë.
sentences.english: "This morning I had forgotten the keys. The door of the apartment closed and I was left outside."

sentences.text: — Pronari kishte një çelës tjetër, por ai ishte në punë. Në banesën time ngrohja punonte, sapuni dhe peshqiri ishin në banjë dhe unë isha në shkallë.
sentences.english: "The owner had another key, but he was at work. In my flat the heating was working, the soap and the towel were in the bathroom and I was on the stairs."

sentences.text: — Dhe sigurisht kisha frikë se do të vija vonë gjithë ditën.
sentences.english: "And of course I was afraid I would arrive late all day."

sentences.text: — Pastaj mendova mirë: ku e kisha lënë çelësin?
sentences.english: "Then I thought hard: where had I left the key?"

sentences.text: — E kisha lënë në frigorifer, pranë qumështit!
sentences.english: "I had left it in the refrigerator, next to the milk!"

sentences.text: — Në frigorifer? — pyeti Ardi.
sentences.english: "In the refrigerator?" asked Ardi.

sentences.text: — Po! Kur isha në ballkon, e kisha marrë qumështin dhe çelësin bashkë.
sentences.english: "Yes! When I was on the balcony, I had taken the milk and the key together."

sentences.text: — Atëherë hyra nga ballkoni i fqinjit dhe e hapa derën nga brenda.
sentences.english: "Then I went in from the neighbour's balcony and opened the door from the inside."

sentences.text: Të gjithë qeshën, edhe Ardi, edhe Ana.
sentences.english: Everybody laughed, even Ardi, even Ana.

sentences.text: — Ndoshta çelësi kishte nevojë për një pushim, — tha Sami, — dhe e gjeta vërtet aty ku e kisha lënë.
sentences.english: "Perhaps the key needed a rest," said Sam, "and I really found it where I had left it."

sentences.text: — Sa ditë e gjatë! — tha Drita.
sentences.english: "What a long day!" said Drita.

sentences.text: — Çelësat nuk janë gjithmonë atje ku i lëmë.
sentences.english: "Keys are not always where we leave them."

sentences.text: — Sot isha veçanërisht i lodhur, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "Today I was especially tired," said Ardi.

sentences.text: — Por tani jam i gëzuar, veçanërisht kur ju qeshni.
sentences.english: "But now I am cheerful, especially when you laugh."

sentences.text: Pas darkës të gjithë u ulën rreth tavolinës.
sentences.english: After dinner everybody sat down around the table.

sentences.text: Drita mori një libër të vogël dhe lexoi një kapitull nga ungjilli.
sentences.english: Drita took a small book and read a chapter from the gospel.

sentences.text: Pastaj lexoi një psalm dhe një varg që fliste për paqen.
sentences.english: Then she read a psalm and a verse that spoke of peace.

sentences.text: — Kur kemi një ditë të keqe, — tha ajo, — kemi nevojë për besim, për fe dhe për shpresë.
sentences.english: "When we have a bad day," she said, "we need trust, faith and hope."

sentences.text: — Një i krishterë nuk ka frikë nga një ditë e vështirë, sepse e di që Perëndia është me të.
sentences.english: "A Christian is not afraid of a hard day, because he knows that God is with him."

sentences.text: — Unë kam një dëshmi për këtë, — tha Sami.
sentences.english: "I have a testimony about this," said Sam.

sentences.text: — Në fillim isha i huaj këtu dhe kisha dyshuar shumë. Tani ndjej gëzim.
sentences.english: "At the beginning I was a stranger here and I had doubted a lot. Now I feel joy."

sentences.text: — Si misionar, ky është misioni im: të jem këtu me ju.
sentences.english: "As a missionary, this is my mission: to be here with you."

sentences.text: — Kuptimi i një dite të keqe vjen më vonë, — tha Drita.
sentences.english: "The meaning of a bad day comes later," said Drita.

sentences.text: — Ky është mësimi i urtësisë.
sentences.english: "This is the lesson of wisdom."

sentences.text: — Falja është edhe liri, — shtoi Ana.
sentences.english: "Forgiveness is also freedom," added Ana.

sentences.text: — Kur i japim njerëzve falje, jemi më të lirë.
sentences.english: "When we give people forgiveness, we are freer."

sentences.text: — Dhe lavdi i qoftë Perëndisë për çdo ditë, — tha gjyshja.
sentences.english: "And glory be to God for every day," said grandmother.

sentences.text: — Sam, çfarë roli ke ti në këtë familje? — pyeti Ardi.
sentences.english: "Sam, what role do you have in this family?" asked Ardi.

sentences.text: — Unë? — qeshi Sami.
sentences.english: "Me?" laughed Sam.

sentences.text: — Mendoj se jam vullnetari i dytë pas gjyshes!
sentences.english: "I think I am the second volunteer after grandmother!"

sentences.text: Para se të shkonin, Drita vendosi të falënderojë Perëndinë me një lutje të shkurtër.
sentences.english: Before they went, Drita decided to thank God with a short prayer.

sentences.text: Ajo e falënderoi për shpëtimin, për kryqin dhe për hirin, dhe të gjithë u përulën.
sentences.english: She thanked him for salvation, for the cross and for grace, and all of them humbled themselves.

sentences.text: Ardi qeshi edhe ai. Tani ai ishte një djalë i qetë.
sentences.english: Ardi laughed too. Now he was a calm boy.

sentences.text: Ai e kishte harruar çelësin, por nuk e kishte harruar se kishte një familje që e donte.
sentences.english: He had forgotten the key, but he had not forgotten that he had a family that loved him.
